college.name: Sri Manakula Vinayagar Engineering College
college.type: Autonomous institution affiliated to Pondicherry University

programs.name: B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering
programs.eligibility: Pass in 10+2 with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry with minimum 50% aggregate marks (45% for reserved categories); admission through counselling based on 10+2 marks / entrance rank as per Pondicherry Government norms.
programs.about: Covers programming, data structures, DBMS, networks, AI & ML, cloud computing and full-stack development.

programs.name: B.Tech Electronics and Communication Engineering
programs.eligibility: Pass in 10+2 with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry with minimum 50% aggregate marks (45% for reserved categories).
programs.about: Covers electronic circuits, signals and systems, VLSI design, embedded systems and communication networks.

programs.name: B.Tech Mechanical Engineering
programs.eligibility: Pass in 10+2 with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry with minimum 50% aggregate marks (45% for reserved categories).
programs.about: Covers thermodynamics, design of machines, manufacturing technology, CAD/CAM and thermal engineering.

programs.name: B.Tech Civil Engineering
programs.eligibility: Pass in 10+2 with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry with minimum 50% aggregate marks (45% for reserved categories).
programs.about: Covers structural engineering, geotechnical engineering, transportation engineering and construction management.

programs.name: B.Tech Information Technology
programs.eligibility: Pass in 10+2 with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry with minimum 50% aggregate marks (45% for reserved categories).
programs.about: Covers software engineering, web technologies, data analytics, information security and cloud services.

programs.name: B.Tech Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
programs.eligibility: Pass in 10+2 with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry with minimum 50% aggregate marks (45% for reserved categories).
programs.about: Covers machine learning, deep learning, data engineering, NLP and AI application development.

admission_procedure: Obtain the application form online from the college website or in person from the admission cell.
Submit the completed application with copies of 10th and 12th mark sheets and transfer certificate.
Applications are shortlisted on the basis of 10+2 marks and, where applicable, government entrance / counselling rank.
Shortlisted candidates are called for certificate verification at the admission cell.
Pay the first-year fees online or by demand draft to confirm the seat.
Report on the notified date with original certificates for enrolment and hostel booking if required.

facilities.name: Central Library
facilities.description: Over 45,000 volumes, national and international journals, digital library with DELNET access and a dedicated reference section.

facilities.name: Computer Laboratories
facilities.description: Separate labs for programming, networks, AI & data science and cloud computing with high-speed internet on all nodes.

facilities.name: Smart Classrooms
facilities.description: Wi-Fi enabled, projector and audio equipped classrooms supporting digital teaching.

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: Separate boys and girls hostels with warden supervision, reading rooms and indoor games; hygienic vegetarian and non-vegetarian mess.

facilities.name: Transport
facilities.description: College buses operating on all major routes from Puducherry and Villianur to the campus.

facilities.name: Sports Complex
facilities.description: Cricket ground, football ground, basketball and volleyball courts, indoor games and a modern gym.

facilities.name: Placement Cell
facilities.description: Training in aptitude, coding and soft skills; campus recruitment with regular and core companies visiting every year.

facilities.name: Medical Room
facilities.description: First-aid room on campus with a visiting doctor and tie-up with a nearby hospital for emergencies.

faqs.a: A limited number of seats are filled under the management quota as per the norms of the Government of Puducherry; contact the admission cell for details.
Eligible students can avail state and central government scholarships, and the college offers merit scholarships for toppers of each branch.
Hostel rooms are allotted on first-come-first-served basis after admission confirmation; early fee payment is advised.

faqs.q: Can I change my branch after admission?
faqs.a: Branch transfer is possible after the first year subject to vacancy and academic performance as per university norms.

faqs.q: Does the college accept JEE Main scores?
faqs.a: Admission is primarily counselling based; JEE Main scores are considered for management-quota shortlisting where applicable.
